objective: Certify, for placement 159 on the 3 x 4 torus, configurations whose cylinder along an odd class has an assignment while no simple cycle of the wall graph passes the criterion of the wall theorem, and show that the crossing wall of a cover assignment is then a closed walk that visits a wall state twice: simple cycles cannot replace closed walks for the honeycomb contacts with a free place.
status: Proved by WALLS-WITH-CHOICES-20261024-001D-P001 (V1 prose proof, standard-library check passed). For placement 159 on the 3 x 4 torus in twist 11, three certified configurations have an assignment along an odd class while no simple cycle of the wall graph passes the criterion of the wall theorem; every good closed walk visits a wall state twice, and the crossing wall of a cover assignment (classes (3, 3), (-3, -3), (-3, -1)) is one. Simple cycles are an incomplete decider for the honeycomb contacts with a free place.
title: Good walls that repeat themselves
